
<!-- Path = fonts/, ...  -->
<!-- Choose fonts for use with xelatex  -->
\setmainfont[
  Path=assets/fonts/,
  Mapping=tex-text,
  Numbers=OldStyle,
  UprightFont=MinionPro-Regular.otf,
  BoldFont=MinionPro-Bold.otf,
  ItalicFont=MinionPro-It.otf,
  BoldItalicFont=MinionPro-BoldIt.otf
]{MinionPro-Regular.otf}

\setsansfont[
  Path=assets/fonts/,
  Mapping=tex-text,
  Color=black,
  UprightFont=MYRIADPRO-REGULAR.OTF,
  BoldFont=MYRIADPRO-BOLD.OTF,
  ItalicFont=MYRIADPRO-REGULAR.OTF,
  BoldItalicFont=MYRIADPRO-BOLDIT.OTF
]{MYRIADPRO-REGULAR.OTF}

\setmonofont[
  Path=assets/fonts/,
  Mapping=tex-text,
  Scale=0.9
]{Consolas.ttf}
